question: Who became the first Indian to win the prestigious Zurich Diamond League Final 2022 in Switzerland?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra** achieved a remarkable feat by winning the prestigious** Zurich Diamond League Final 2022 **with an outstanding throw of 88.44 meters, setting a new personal best and claiming the title of the best throw of the year.
 
• Despite starting with a foul, Chopra quickly ascended to the top spot with his exceptional throw of 88.44 meters in his second attempt, marking his fourth career best.
 
• This remarkable performance secured his victory in the competition. In his subsequent throws, Chopra recorded distances of 88.00 meters, 86.11 meters, 87.00 meters, and 83.6
